definitionsIntro: Define credentials that each member supplies for themselves. You set the shape here; every user enters their own value under My secrets. Coverage shows how many members have set a value — never the values themselves.
noDefinitions: No user secret definitions yet. Create one to require each member to supply their own credential.
definitionDialogDescription: Members supply their own value for this credential. No value is entered here.
stableKeyHelp: Stable identifier referenced by env bindings.
usageGuidancePlaceholder: Tell members how to create their token, required scopes, etc.
removeDefinitionSuffix: for the whole company. Existing member values become unreferenced. This cannot be undone.
valueDescription: This value is yours only. It is used when you are the user responsible for a run that needs
externalReferenceHelp: Points at your own credential in the configured provider. Paperclip stores the reference, not the value.
encryptedHelp: Stored encrypted. Never shown back to anyone, including admins.
missingBanner: {{count}} user secret(s) you are responsible for have no value yet. Runs that require them will fail until you set your value.
mySecretsIntro: These are credentials only you provide. Each value is yours alone — used when you are the user responsible for a run — and is never shown back to anyone, including admins.
missingCount: {{count}} required secret(s) still need your value.
noUserSecrets: No user secrets are defined for this company yet. An admin defines which credentials each member supplies.
stageNoAutomation: Secrets are available only to step automation. Pick an agent to run this step, then add the secrets it needs.
stageIntroBefore: These env vars are injected when
stageIntroAfter: runs this step. They override matching project and agent env on collisions.
approveSecretDescription: The value is created as the proposing agent recorded it. Re-folder or rename it before it lands.
approveBindingDescription: Grant the target agent access to this secret. This runs with your permissions.
rejectDescription: The reason is sent back to
noApprovePermission: You don’t have permission to approve this.
noPendingProposalsMessage: When an agent proposes a secret or an access binding, it shows up here for review.
proposalsIntro: Agents propose credentials and access bindings; you approve or reject them here. Proposed values are never shown — only a fingerprint and length.
nameMax: Name must be 160 characters or fewer.
